title: How fast a tiny error grows
caption: In a chaotic system errors grow exponentially, δ = δ₀e^(λt). For the double pendulum, λ ≈ 2 s⁻¹: an error of 10⁻⁶ rad reaches 1 rad after ln(10⁶)/2 ≈ 7 s. On a log scale the growth is a straight line; a thousand times better measurement buys only another 3.5 s.
alt: Base-10 logarithm of the error against time, a straight line rising from minus 6 at time zero to zero at about 7 seconds.
description: log₁₀ δ = −6 + λt / ln 10, λ = 2 s⁻¹.
δ = 1 rad (log₁₀ δ = 0) at t = ln(10⁶)/2 = 6.91 s.
Each factor of 10 costs ln 10 / 2 ≈ 1.15 s.

checks.name: the error reaches 1 rad at 6.91 s
